en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: There will be 100 points to get during the course. Two essays and their presentation/discussion (60 %) - Everyone got assigned two essays to write and present throughout the semester, each for 30 points. Each essay should be submitted by Wednesday midnight before the class where you are supposed to present and discuss the essay. The length is 1000-1500 words, and you are supposed to quote sources using hyperlinks or standard academic referencing. The essay can be submitted through Microsoft Teams group (please notify us in the chat that you have submitted it). Active participation in the classes (40 %) - You are expected to be present at all classes and be able to actively participate in the discussion. If you miss some classes or are repeatedly not able to join the discussion and basic questions, we may need to organize a final oral exam in which you will prove that you have learnt basic knowledge of the course. Evaluation scale A: 100 – 90 % B: 89 – 80 % C: 79 – 70 % D: 69 – 65 % E: 64 – 60 % F: 59 – 0 %
